limitations: Quantized scalar values are bounded, not universally lossless.
MR is a documented Standard Extended SOP Class; strict base-IOD findings remain visible.
These CT phases are ten separate 3D conversions, not an inferred temporal CT series.
Clinical/anatomical correctness and unknown upstream NIfTI provenance are not established.
Enhanced/gated profiles, overlapping/probabilistic/time-varying SEG remain outside supported scope.
New scalar cases did not run segmentation inference; existing synthetic SEG viewer fixtures were rechecked.
Slicer acceptance is limited to tested installation and profiles; other receivers require acceptance.
